6. **Quit Smoking**: Smoking weakens the LES, increasing your risk of developing GERD symptoms. Quitting smoking can significantly improve symptoms.

7. **Manage Stress**: High levels of stress can exacerbate GERD symptoms. Try relaxation techniques such as deep breathing exercises, meditation, yoga, or other stress-reducing activities.

4. **Flexible Sigmoidoscopy**: This test examines the lower part of the colon and rectum. It requires less extensive bowel preparation than a full colonoscopy and is generally less uncomfortable. It should be repeated every 5 years.
